concepts.title: Preparation and execution require different attention

evidence_assessments.title: Unlimited creative mechanism and stress-free work
evidence_assessments.content: The text characterizes an inner mechanism as having unlimited capacity. Metaphor cannot prove unlimited mental resources or eliminate fatigue and stress.
